## 1. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Core libraries
library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(progressr)
library(lhs) # For Latin Hypercube Sampling

# Load all our custom functions
source("../../R/data_generator.R")
source("../../R/solvers.R")

# --- New LHS Generator for t-distributed features ---
generate_X_t_LHS <- function(n, p, df_X, scale_X = 1, ...) {
  hypercube <- randomLHS(n, p)
  X_raw <- qt(hypercube, df = df_X)
  X_scaled <- X_raw * scale_X
  return(X_scaled)
}
```

## 2. Final Simulation Parameters

```{r}
# --- Final Data Generation Parameters ---
BEST_DF_X <- 2.1
BEST_SCALE_X <- 3
BEST_THETA_MAGNITUDE <- 1 # Coefficients for logistic are typically smaller

# --- Fixed Model Parameters ---
P <- 600
S_STAR <- 5
THETA_STAR <- rep(0, P)
# Generate random coefficients around the magnitude
set.seed(1)
THETA_STAR[1:S_STAR] <- runif(S_STAR, BEST_THETA_MAGNITUDE - 0.5, BEST_THETA_MAGNITUDE + 0.5)

# --- Final Simulation Grid ---
N_SEQUENCE_FINAL <- seq(400, 1600, by=300)
METHODS <- c("RIGHT", "IHT", "Shrinkage", "Lasso")
#METHODS <- c("RIGHT", "IHT")
N_REPS_FINAL <- 200 # Adjust as needed for final run

param_grid_final <- expand.grid(
  n = N_SEQUENCE_FINAL,
  method = METHODS,
  rep_id = 1:N_REPS_FINAL
)

```

## 3. Main Simulation Loop (Parallel)

```{r main-loop-final, cache=TRUE}
# --- Setup Parallel Backend ---
num_cores <- max(1, detectCores() - 1)
registerDoParallel(cores = num_cores)
cat(sprintf("Running FINAL simulation for Logistic Regression on %d cores.\n", num_cores))

# --- Run the loop with a progress bar ---
execution_time <- system.time({
  with_progress({
    p_bar <- progressor(steps = nrow(param_grid_final))
    
    results_list <- foreach(
      i = 1:nrow(param_grid_final),
      .combine = 'rbind',
      .packages = c("dplyr", "glmnet", "lhs")
    ) %dopar% {
      
      p_bar()
      
      # --- Setup for each task ---
      source("../../R/data_generator.R")
      source("../../R/solvers.R")
      
      # Make the LHS generator available to workers
      generate_X_t_LHS <- function(n, p, df_X, scale_X = 1, ...) {
        hypercube <- lhs::randomLHS(n, p)
        X_raw <- stats::qt(hypercube, df = df_X)
        X_scaled <- X_raw * scale_X
        return(X_scaled)
      }
      
      params <- param_grid_final[i, ]
      n <- params$n
      method <- as.character(params$method)
      rep_id <- params$rep_id
      
      set.seed(i)
      
      # Generate LOGISTIC data using LHS for X
      sim_data <- generate_logistic_data(
        n = n, p = P, theta_star = THETA_STAR,
        generator_X = generate_X_t_LHS,
        df_X = BEST_DF_X,
        scale_X = BEST_SCALE_X
      )
      X_full <- sim_data$X
      y_full <- sim_data$y
      
      # --- UNIFIED 80/20 Split for ALL tuning procedures ---
      train_size <- floor(0.8 * n)
      train_idx <- sample(1:n, size = train_size)
      X_train <- X_full[train_idx, ]; y_train <- y_full[train_idx]
      X_val <- X_full[-train_idx, ]; y_val <- y_full[-train_idx]
      
      # --- Run Solver based on Method ---
      theta_hat <- switch(
        method,
        "RIGHT" = {
          s <- 10; c_K <- 4; eta <- 0.02; T_max <- 1500
          K <- max(1, round(c_K * log(P * log(n / log(P)))))
          solver_right(X_full, y_full, s, eta, T_max, K, grad_func_samplewise = grad_logistic_regression_samplewise)
        },
        "IHT" = {
          s <- 10; eta <- 0.02; T_max <- 1500
          solver_iht(X_full, y_full, s, eta, T_max, grad_func = grad_logistic_regression)
        },
        "Lasso" = {
          cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X_train, y_train, family = "binomial", standardize = FALSE, intercept = FALSE)
          lambda_best <- cv_fit$lambda.min
          final_fit <- glmnet(X_full, y_full, lambda = lambda_best, family = "binomial", standardize = FALSE, intercept = FALSE)
          as.vector(final_fit$beta)
        },
        "Shrinkage" = {
          tau_x_fixed <- quantile(abs(X_train), 0.95)
          X_train_shrunk <- truncate_operator(X_train, tau_x_fixed)
          
          cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X_train_shrunk, y_train, family = "binomial", standardize = FALSE, intercept = FALSE)
          lambda_best <- cv_fit$lambda.min
          
          # Final fit on full data
          # Pass a large tau_y to ensure no truncation on the 0/1 response
          solver_shrinkage_method(X_full, y_full, tau_x_fixed, 999, lambda_best, family = "binomial")
        }
      )
      
      # --- Calculate and return results ---
      l2_error <- if(any(is.na(theta_hat))) NA else sqrt(sum((theta_hat - THETA_STAR)^2))
      data.frame(n = n, method = method, rep_id = rep_id, l2_error = l2_error)
    }
  })
})

# --- Stop the parallel cluster ---
stopImplicitCluster()
#cat("重复次数", N_REPS_FINAL, " 花费时间")
#print(execution_time)
```

## 4. Analysis and Visualization

```{r analysis-final}
# The result from foreach is already a combined data frame
local_results_df <- results_list
saveRDS(results_list,"../../results/04_Fourth_simulation_comparison_logistic_model/raw_results.rds")
# Aggregate results
summary_local <- local_results_df %>%
  group_by(n, method) %>%
  summarise(mean_l2_error = mean(l2_error, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

print(summary_local)


# Plot on log-log scale
summary_local <- summary_local %>%
  filter(is.finite(mean_l2_error)) %>%
  mutate(log_n = log(n), log_error = log(mean_l2_error))
saveRDS(summary_local,"../../results/04_Fourth_simulation_comparison_logistic_model/final_results.rds")

# Reorder factor levels for a clean legend
summary_local$method <- factor(summary_local$method, 
                               levels = c("RIGHT", "Shrinkage", "Lasso", "IHT"))

logistic_comparison_final <- ggplot(summary_local, aes(x = log_n, y = log_error, color = method, group = method, shape = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    #title = "Final Comparison: Logistic Regression",
    #subtitle = "Log Mean L2 Error vs. Log Sample Size under Heavy-Tailed Features",
    x = "Log(Sample Size, n)",
    y = "Log(Mean L2 Error)"
  ) +
 theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
         legend.title = element_text(size = 16), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)   )+
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "method",
    values = c("RIGHT" = 16,"Shrinkage" = 15, "Lasso" = 18, "IHT" = 4),
    drop = FALSE # <-- Also here for consistency
  )

print(logistic_comparison_final)
#ggsave("final_comparison_logistic_model.pdf", logistic_comparison_final, height = 4, width = 10, dpi = 300)
#ggsave("final_comparison_logistic_model.png", logistic_comparison_final, height = 4, width = 10, dpi = 300)
```

#Chnage colors
library(ggplot2)

selected_palette <- c(

  "Adaptive Huber" = "#3B82A1",  # Cyan

  "Lasso"          = "#CAB54B" ,# Sand
  "IHT"            = "#CC6677"  # Rose
)
# Reorder factor levels for a clean legend 
summary_local$method <- factor(summary_local$method, 
                               levels = c("RIGHT", "Shrinkage", "Lasso", "IHT"))



logistic_comparison_final <- ggplot(
  summary_local, 
  aes(x = log_n, y = log_error, color = method, group = method, shape = method)
) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(size = 2.9) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Log(Sample Size, n)",
    y = "Log(Mean L2 Error)"

    drop = FALSE 
  ) +
  
 
  scale_shape_manual(

    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )


print(logistic_comparison_final)
ggsave("../../results/04_Fourth_simulation_comparison_logistic_model/final_comparison_logistic_model.pdf", logistic_comparison_final, height = 4, width = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../../results/04_Fourth_simulation_comparison_logistic_model/final_comparison_logistic_model.png", logistic_comparison_final, height = 4, width = 10, dpi = 300)
